product_one_liner.value: Rasayel provides a WhatsApp business platform—including a shared team inbox, campaigns, automation and chatbots—for B2B companies to sell and grow through WhatsApp.
product_one_liner.notes: The company's About page identifies it as a WhatsApp platform helping B2B companies sell and grow on WhatsApp.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and prices are listed.

named_customers.notes: G2's Rasayel listing describes these as case-study customers.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 11–50 employees; the requested band options split this into 11–20 and 21–50, and the company About page lists a 12-person team, supporting 11–20.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn designates the headquarters as Remote, Oregon, United States; no physical city is named.

eng_blog.notes: No technical or engineering blog with two qualifying build-focused posts was found; the available company content is customer/product-oriented rather than an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public docs site contains multiple product and integration help articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No live Rasayel careers/job board could be verified.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public documentation and privacy-policy search did not establish a model provider for Rasayel's AI feature.

compliance_certs.notes: The sources located did not establish whether Rasayel publicly claims any of the listed certifications.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports a 2022 Seed round from Founder Collective, with amount undisclosed; 0 is used as the schema's numeric placeholder for undisclosed amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round found is a 2022 Seed round, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No live company careers page or job board listing current openings was verified.

launched_6mo.notes: The changelog's newest visible update is dated April 28, 2026, before the May 9, 2026 start of the six-month window; no newer launch item was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full team page lists 12 people and identifies the co-founders and roles, but gives no recent leadership starts; no departures were found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot and Salesforce are named in product documentation; Pipedrive has an integration page and Zapier appears in the site integration listing.
